BotCleaner.title: Keep your records clean of bots and spam.
BotCleaner.subtitle: Klaviyo BotCleaner automatically identifies suspicious customer profiles, filters temporary disposable emails, and blocks fraudulent checkouts before they harm your Klaviyo sender reputation.
BotCleaner.note: *One-click installation. No code or theme modifications required.
BotCleaner.probTitle: The Journey from Problem to Solution
BotCleaner.probDesc: Understand step-by-step what leaks your marketing budget, how it impacts your Shopify store, and how we fix it.
BotCleaner.probBox1Desc: The leading email marketing platform for Shopify stores that drives your recurring sales. However, its effectiveness and ROI depend 100% on the quality of your subscribers.
BotCleaner.probBox2Desc: This happens when spambots hit checkouts, discount seekers enter temporary burner addresses (like temp-mail) to grab a 10% coupon, or when people use old inactive emails.
BotCleaner.probBox3Desc: Fake profiles double your Klaviyo fees (e.g., $100 to $150/mo upon reaching 5,000 profiles) and cause hard bounces. Exceeding a 5% bounce rate flags your domain and routes your marketing to SPAM.
BotCleaner.probBox4Desc: This tool is designed to identify these suspicious and temporary profiles and suppress them, lowering your Klaviyo costs and reducing the likelihood of your legitimate emails ending up in the SPAM folder for your other users.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion1: How does BotCleaner identify bot accounts?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer1:
The app does not blindly decide "this contact is fake". Instead, it assigns a suspicion score using explainable and conservative signals.

It evaluates factors such as:

1. Malformed email: incomplete addresses or invalid structures.
2. Temporary domain: emails from disposable/tempmail services.
3. Strange email patterns: excessive numbers, random strings, or suspicious characters.
4. Clearly fake name: values like "test", "fake", "unknown", "admin", or similar.
5. Role-based emails: addresses like admin@, noreply@, support@, when they appear unusual in a customer signup.
6. Incomplete metadata: profiles lacking normal creation or update timestamps.
7. Suppression status: if a profile has already been suppressed in Klaviyo, it is not displayed as pending.

It is safe because the app does not suppress automatically. First, it shows the profile, its score, and the exact reasons why it was flagged. Furthermore, missing a first/last name carries almost no penalty, as many real customers leave this blank. A contact needs to gather multiple strong signals to be flagged as high-risk.

The final decision is always made by the merchant. The app acts as an auditor: it detects patterns, explains the risk, and lets you review before taking action. And because the primary action is suppression, not permanent deletion, it is completely safe and reversible directly inside Klaviyo.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion2: Will it block my real customers?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer2: No. BotCleaner operates under the Merchant Control principle. The app audits your lists and flags suspicious contacts in a manual review panel. You always have full oversight and decide which profiles to suppress.
BotCleaner.faqQuestion3: How does this help my Klaviyo deliverability?
BotCleaner.faqAnswer3: Klaviyo and other email platforms calculate your sender reputation based on open and bounce rates. If you have 1,000 inactive or temporary bot accounts on your lists, your emails will bounce and your open rates will drop, pushing your legitimate campaigns straight into the SPAM folder. Cleaning them ensures maximum deliverability.
